i felt like a failure.zh: 我觉得自己是个失败者。

i felt like i was ready to explode.en: I felt like I was ready to explode

i felt nervous.note: nervous指神经紧绷、坐立不安的躯体化紧张感，与「焦虑」区分。

i get fixated on certain things and can'.en: I get fixated on certain things and can’t stop.

i get stuck on things a lot.en: I get stuck on things a lot.
i get stuck on things a lot.note: 泛指思维或行为反复固着、难以摆脱，为 perseveration 的概括题。

i get very nervous when i think about th.en: I get very nervous when I think about the future.

i got enough sleep.note: 正向睡眠条目，评自认睡眠量是否够，反向计分时不可改译为「睡得不够」。

i hate to take chances.note: 风险承担的负向计分：厌恶冒险提示冒险性低；chances 此处指风险。

i have a strict way of doing things.en: I have a strict way of doing things.
i have a strict way of doing things.note: 测僵化完美主义中的刻板与规矩取向，指做事方式固定、不灵活，而非单纯要求高。
i have a strict way of doing things.zh: 我做事有一套严格的方式。

i have a very short temper.en: I have a very short temper.
i have a very short temper.note: 测敌意与易激惹倾向，指容易被小事引爆、发火门槛低。

i have much stronger emotional reactions.note: 测情绪易变性，强调反应强度高于他人，而非情绪低落。
i have much stronger emotional reactions.zh: 我的情绪反应比几乎所有人都强烈得多。

i have no limits when it comes to doing.en: I have no limits when it comes to doing dangerous things.
i have no limits when it comes to doing.note: 测冒险倾向，指对危险行为缺乏自我约束，不等于追求刺激的愉悦。
i have no limits when it comes to doing.zh: 在冒险做危险的事情上，我毫无底线。

i have no worth as a person.en: I have no worth as a person.
i have no worth as a person.note: 测抑郁性中的无价值感，是对整体自我价值的否定，而非仅对某件事自责。
i have no worth as a person.zh: 我作为一个人毫无价值。

i have outstanding qualities that few ot.en: I have outstanding qualities that few others possess.
i have outstanding qualities that few ot.note: 测夸大，指自认独特优越；为正向自评题，不是自谦或自我怀疑。

i have periods in which i feel disconnec.note: 测知觉失调中的解离体验，指间歇性疏离感，并非持续的情绪低落。
i have periods in which i feel disconnec.zh: 我有时会感到与世界或与自己脱节。

i have several habits that others find e.en: I have several habits that others find eccentric or strange.
i have several habits that others find e.note: 测古怪性，从他人视角评价自己的行为习惯怪异，而非自认与众不同。
i have several habits that others find e.zh: 我有几个别人觉得古怪或奇怪的习惯。

i have some unusual abilities, like some.en: I have some unusual abilities, like sometimes knowing exactly what someone is thinking.
i have some unusual abilities, like some.note: 测异常信念与体验，指类特异功能式的信念，属精神病性谱系而非社交敏感。
i have some unusual abilities, like some.zh: 我有些不同寻常的能力，比如有时能准确知道别人在想什么。

i have trouble changing how i'm doing so.en: I have trouble changing how I’m doing something even if what I’m doing isn’t going well.
i have trouble changing how i'm doing so.note: 测 perseveration（坚持同一做法），指难以灵活调整方法，非指缺少目标。
i have trouble changing how i'm doing so.zh: 即使我做事的方式进展不顺，我也很难改变它。

i have trouble keeping my mind focused o.en: I have trouble keeping my mind focused on what needs to be done.
i have trouble keeping my mind focused o.note: 测注意涣散，指难以维持对任务的专注，而非缺乏动机或能力。
i have trouble keeping my mind focused o.zh: 我很难把注意力集中在需要完成的事情上。

i have trouble pursuing specific goals e.en: I have trouble pursuing specific goals even for short periods of time.
i have trouble pursuing specific goals e.note: 测注意涣散，强调难以持续投入目标，与是否有目标无关。
i have trouble pursuing specific goals e.zh: 即使只是短时间内，我也很难坚持追求具体目标。

i just skip appointments or meetings if.en: I just skip appointments or meetings if I’m not in the mood.
i just skip appointments or meetings if.note: 测不负责任，指凭一时心情放弃应尽义务，而非单纯社交回避。
i just skip appointments or meetings if.zh: 如果没心情，我就会直接不去赴约或开会。

i keep approaching things the same way,.en: I keep approaching things the same way, even when it isn’t working.
i keep approaching things the same way,.note: 测 perseveration，指明知无效仍重复原有做法，别误读为做事有恒心。
i keep approaching things the same way,.zh: 即使这种做法不管用，我还是用同样的方式处理事情。

i keep to myself.note: 测退缩，指主动回避社交、独来独往，而非被动被孤立。

i keep trying to make things perfect, ev.note: 测僵化完美主义，强调明知已足够仍不肯停手的高标准。
i keep trying to make things perfect, ev.zh: 即使事情已经做到能达到的最好程度，我仍不断试图让它完美。

i know i'll commit suicide sooner or lat.en: I know I’ll commit suicide sooner or later.
i know i'll commit suicide sooner or lat.note: 测抑郁性中的自杀意念，属高危条目，作答阳性时须评估风险。
i know i'll commit suicide sooner or lat.zh: 我知道自己迟早会自杀。

i like being a person who gets noticed.en: I like being a person who gets noticed.
i like being a person who gets noticed.note: 测寻求关注，指享受被他人留意，不涉及社交焦虑或担心被评价。
i like being a person who gets noticed.zh: 我喜欢做一个受人注意的人。

i like standing out in a crowd.en: I like standing out in a crowd.
i like standing out in a crowd.note: 测寻求关注，强调乐于从人群中凸显自己，非指不合群的孤立。
i like standing out in a crowd.zh: 我喜欢在人群中引人注目。

i like to draw attention to myself.en: I like to draw attention to myself.
i like to draw attention to myself.note: 测寻求关注，指主动成为焦点，是自我表现的意愿而非被关注的需要。
i like to draw attention to myself.zh: 我喜欢把别人的注意力吸引到自己身上。

i like to take risks.note: 测冒险倾向，指享受冒险本身，程度轻于无底线的危险行为。

i lose track of conversations because ot.note: 测注意涣散，指交谈中易被外物分心，而非听不懂或不愿听。
i lose track of conversations because ot.zh: 我会因为其他事物吸引我的注意而跟不上谈话。

i love getting the attention of other pe.en: I love getting the attention of other people.
i love getting the attention of other pe.note: 测寻求关注，强调获得他人注意带来的愉悦，与自信高低无关。
i love getting the attention of other pe.zh: 我很喜欢得到别人的关注。

i make promises that i don't really inte.zh: 我会做出自己其实并不打算兑现的承诺。

i make up stories about things that happ.zh: 我会就发生过的事编造完全不符合事实的说法。

i never know where my emotions will go f.en: I never know where my emotions will go from moment to moment.
i never know where my emotions will go f.note: 测情绪走向难以预料、变化无常，属情绪易变性；非指不了解或不善表达情绪。
i never know where my emotions will go f.zh: 我从不知道自己的情绪下一刻会转向哪里

i never show emotions to others.en: I never show emotions to others.
i never show emotions to others.note: 反向计分：测情绪表达受抑制、不外露，属情感受限；并非内心没有情绪。
i never show emotions to others.zh: 我从不对他人表露情绪

i never take risks.note: 反向计分：测对冒险的回避，属冒险倾向低；并非不敢面对困难或缺乏勇气。

i never want tobe alone.note: 测对独处的排斥、需人陪伴，属分离不安；原文“tobe”缺空格系排版噪声，照实直译。

i often feel like a failure.en: I often feel like a failure.
i often feel like a failure.note: 测把自我整体评价为失败，属抑郁；非指某件具体事情没做好。
i often feel like a failure.zh: 我常常觉得自己是个失败者

i often feel like nothing i do really ma.en: I often feel like nothing I do really matters.
i often feel like nothing i do really ma.note: 测所做之事毫无意义的无价值感，属抑郁；非指别人不重视自己。
i often feel like nothing i do really ma.zh: 我常常觉得我做什么都无关紧要

i often forget to pay my bills.en: I often forget to pay my bills.
i often forget to pay my bills.note: 以缴费这类日常事务测责任履行的疏忽，属不负责任；非指记性差。

i often get into physical fights.note: 测主动卷入肢体冲突的攻击行为，属冷酷无情；非指遭人攻击或正当防卫。
i often get into physical fights.zh: 我常常和别人动手打架

i often have ideas that are too unusual.note: 词眼是 unusual（离奇反常），测古怪想法，属古怪性；不是想法太高深而说不出来。
i often have ideas that are too unusual.zh: 我常常有一些离奇得无法向任何人解释的想法

i often have to deal with people who are.zh: 我常常不得不与不如我重要的人打交道

i often have unusual experiences, such a.note: 测实际无人在场时的临场感，属异常信念与体验；并非直觉敏锐或思念某人。
i often have unusual experiences, such a.zh: 我常常有不同寻常的体验，比如感到有某人在场，其实那人并不在

i often make up things about myself to h.note: 测为达目的而虚构自我信息的欺骗，属欺骗性；非指善意夸张或开玩笑。
i often make up things about myself to h.zh: 我常常编造关于自己的事来帮我得到想要的东西

i often say things that others find odd.en: I often say things that others find odd or strange.
i often say things that others find odd.note: 以他人观感为准测言语的古怪性，属古怪性；非指口才差或说错话。
i often say things that others find odd.zh: 我常常说些别人觉得古怪或奇怪的话

i often see unusual connections between.en: I often see unusual connections between things that most people miss.
i often see unusual connections between.note: 测知觉到常人忽略的异常关联，属异常信念与体验；不是夸自己观察力敏锐。
i often see unusual connections between.zh: 我常常看出事物之间大多数人没注意到的奇特联系

i often see vivid dream like images when.en: I often see vivid dream-like images when I’m falling asleep or waking up.
i often see vivid dream like images when.note: 测入睡或醒来时的梦样意象，属知觉失调；与普通夜间做梦不同。
i often see vivid dream like images when.zh: 我在快睡着或刚醒来时常常看到生动的、像梦一样的画面

i often worry that something bad will ha.zh: 我常常担心因为自己过去犯的错会发生不好的事

i prefer being alone to having a close r.zh: 比起有亲密的恋人，我更愿意独处

i prefer not to get too close to people.note: 测人际亲近上的主动回避，属退缩；与想亲近却害怕的社交焦虑不同。
i prefer not to get too close to people.zh: 我宁愿不和别人走得太近

i prefer to keep romance out of my life.note: 测刻意不让恋爱进入生活的偏好，属亲密回避；非指对性不感兴趣。
i prefer to keep romance out of my life.zh: 我宁愿把恋爱排除在我的生活之外

i prefer to play it safe rather than tak.note: 反向计分：测宁可稳妥也不冒无谓风险的偏好，属冒险倾向低；非指优柔寡断。
i prefer to play it safe rather than tak.zh: 我宁愿稳妥行事，也不去冒不必要的风险

i rarely get enthusiastic about anything.en: I rarely get enthusiastic about anything.
i rarely get enthusiastic about anything.note: 测快感缺失；指对各类活动普遍缺乏兴趣与热情，并非一时情绪低落。
